Ram Mandir Trust Meeting to Discuss Champat Rai's Future and SIT Probe

The Ram Mandir Trust is scheduled to hold a crucial meeting where the future of its general secretary, Champat Rai, is expected to be discussed. Reports indicate that a Special Investigation Team (SIT) probe may also be on the agenda. This meeting comes at a significant time for the trust overseeing the temple's affairs.
